{{Quote|They have insertion skills. Combat skills. We don't know yet if those X-wings were actually StealthXs or regular X-wings dressed up to look that way. '''Glitterby Base''' was an underground facility managed by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. It was infiltrated by the newly reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref>
